svg.title: Predicted weekday water use at four temperatures against a plan limit of five million gallons
svg.desc: Four small panels, each a bell-shaped predictive density for one weekday's water use with the region above five million gallons shaded and its probability labelled.
svg.text: The same plan limit, four temperatures, four very different decisions
One weekday's predicted use, drawn with the full predictive spread: fitted-mean uncertainty and residual scatter together.
Each spread combines the fitted mean's uncertainty with the residual 0.1015, so it is wider than the residual alone. What size of shaded area is worth acting on comes from somewhere else.
